title: bee project plan
description: The project's plan as data: pieces of work, their status, dependencies and estimates. The docs site renders the Project section from it, and a bee board can be seeded from it: `items` is an object keyed by stable id (one object per item, replaced whole on write) and `order` is a list of ids (an Rga of ids on the board). Every value is plain JSON, so the YAML that holds it uses no anchors, tags or unquoted dates.

as_of.description: When the file was last reconciled with GitHub, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

sources.description: Where the data comes from, in reading order.

columns.description: One column per status. On a board, these are a Board notion's columns.

owner.description: Who moves items out of this column, when that is one party.

order.description: Every item id exactly once, in display order.

id.description: Stable, never reused. Prefixes: task- (a plan task), bee- (a bee issue or PR), kuilt- (a kuilt issue or PR), out- (work outside the code).

estimate.description: A range, always labelled as an estimate, with what it rests on. Wall-clock time from start to merge, not counting time waiting on Iain.

basis.description: Why this range: the merge history or plan text it comes from.

kind.description: task: a task in the v1 plan. pr: a pull request. issue: a bug or follow-up. decision: a question for Iain. kuilt: kuilt work bee depends on. outside: work outside the code.

summary.description: One sentence: what it is, or what it waits for.

parent.description: The item this one is part of.

depends_on.description: Items that must be done before this one can finish.

landed.description: When it merged or closed. Required when status is done.
